system.description:
You collect and build illusionary chakra, attempting to inject a sense of impudence in your foes.

Select one creature you can see within range, forcing them to make a Charisma saving throw.

Critical Success: Affected creature is able to resist most of this jutsu’s effects.

Success: Affected creature increases the cost of the next jutsu they cast by +4, before the end of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creatures cannot upcast their jutsu for the duration. If they would attempt to do so, they still spend the chakra, but its effects remains its base rank.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but the affected creature must attempt to upcast their jutsu cast to the highest rank possible, spending the chakra as normal, but its effects remain as its base rank.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of creatures you can target by +1.
